<insights>
- The horse Borrego ran in several races with a distance of one and one-fourth miles.
- The races listed with this distance are: Breeders' Cup Classic, Jockey Club Gold Cup, and Santa Anita Handicap.
- The triple crown races are the Kentucky Derby, Preakness Stakes, and Belmont Stakes.
</insights>

<answer>
The race in the Race Record of the horse Borrego with a distance of one and one-fourth miles that is also one of the three races to win the triple crown is the Breeders' Cup Classic.
</answer>

<subanswer>
- The Breeders' Cup Classic is one of the three races that make up the triple crown.
</subanswer>
